title: Electrical Diagnostic Fee by Size of the Source Repair (Workmanship Warranties Rate Card)
content:
**Rate.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the electrical diagnostic charge on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty is built on the electrical diagnostic fee. The electrical diagnostic fee follows the labor hours quoted on the customer-pay repair order the coverage was issued on, held under Customer-Pay Repairs:

| Labor hours quoted on the source Customer-Pay Repairs order | Electrical diagnostic fee |
|---|---|
| the heavy-repair hours, 40, or more | the heavy-repair electrical fee, USD 129.95 |
| the mid-repair hours, 20, or more, but fewer than 40 | the mid-repair electrical fee, USD 109.95 |
| fewer than 20 | the plan's standard diagnostic fee |
| coverage not issued on a customer-pay repair order | the plan's standard diagnostic fee |

## Boundary readings (hypothetical hours)

| Quoted labor hours | Electrical diagnostic fee |
|---|---|
| 40.0 | USD 129.95 |
| 39.9 | USD 109.95 |
| 20.0 | USD 109.95 |
| 19.9 | the plan's standard diagnostic fee |

## Notes

- Only the labor hours quoted on the repair order the coverage was issued on are read.
- A coverage issued on an insurance claim repair rather than a customer-pay repair order takes the plan's standard diagnostic fee as its electrical diagnostic fee.
